| `L2-PLATFORM-SHELL/R-3` | The styleguide: one page for administrators that shows the tokens and the Platform's style names with the values the two stylesheets hold, the plain parts that exist today, and every shared page part in each state, drawn by its macro with its call beside it. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/shell_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/styleguide.html` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-SHELL/R-4` | The shared page parts: the pieces every new screen is built from - the one centred column, the page head, a section, a card, a row of a list, tabs, the status dot, the tag, the numbered reference and the link - as template macros with fixed names and arguments, and their style rules (classes that start with k-, values from the brand tokens only). Whatever a macro is given reaches the page as text. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/_parts.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/parts.css` |

### Not responsible for

- Deciding who may enter an area; each area's routes refuse on their own (the console's role gates, the Builder's permissions). The link is presentation.
- Computing which links a person gets; today the Platform's web app does (app.py, \_sidebar_context, \_console_url and \_builder_nav).
- The content of the pages.
- The values of the brand tokens; the brand kit owns them (KnowledgeBase, brand/knovas-brand), and this repository carries its file unchanged.

### Terms

- area (Workspace, Verwaltung or Builder)
- token (a named value of the brand - a colour, a type size, a spacing step, a radius, a shadow - that the style rules take instead of a value of their own)
- page part (one of the shared pieces a screen is built from - a macro of \_parts.html and its rules in parts.css)
